ads.title: Assets. Shared.
ads.primary: Keep your game's vehicles and props in a shared asset library with Tripo Studio Team Plan. Find, reuse and keep creating.
ads.headline: A shared asset library for your game team
ads.audience: US game studio leads, art leads and production teams
ads.angle: Workflow efficiency through a shared, reusable vehicle and prop library.
ads.visual: One direct shared-assets claim replaces the longer two-part headline. Removed the Find/Share/Reuse sidebar, repeated metadata and footer copy. A single shared-library band and team icon connect the large, complete rover to the collaboration use case. Final spacing revision: centered the image at 1024 × 600 within its 1072px pale-gray container, retaining cover and 42.5% vertical positioning, to increase breathing room around the mast and wheels. Viewed again at 1200 and 360 pixels.
ads.evidenceNote: Shared asset organization and reuse are verified capabilities, subject to team permissions. The pictured collection is concept artwork, not Tripo model output or proof of measured time savings.

ads.title: Create together. Build on it.
ads.primary: Bring your game assets, shared credits and member controls into one workspace with Tripo Studio Team Plan.
ads.headline: One workspace for your game team's assets
ads.audience: US game studio leads, art leads and production teams
ads.angle: Reduce fragmented asset handoffs through centralized assets and team administration.
ads.visual: Removed repeated workspace/footer statements and asset numbers. One continuous shared-library heading groups the character and environment without pretending to show the actual product UI. Retained brand yellow and assembled the logo from original official PNG crops on a black icon backing; no logo redraw.
ads.evidenceNote: Shared workspace, team credits and member administration are verified. Less file chasing is a qualitative benefit, not a quantified efficiency result or real-time co-editing promise.

ads.title: A world to build. A place to share.
ads.primary: From harbor props to environment assets, keep your game's 3D work together with Tripo Studio Team Plan.
ads.headline: A shared workspace for your next game world
ads.audience: European game studio leads, environment-art leads and project teams
ads.angle: A concrete game project: keep a harbor world's assets together for the team.
ads.visual: The purpose sentence names an exploration-game project and explicitly links its assets to a shared workspace. Removed the micro-inventory and duplicate footer slogan. Preserved the main tower and environment, with one left-aligned text system and a contrast gradient.
ads.evidenceNote: The shared workspace is verified. The harbor is a project-use illustration, not a customer game, engine capture, or promise to generate a complete world.

ads.title: One game. One library.
ads.primary: Characters, props and environments. Organize your game's 3D assets in one shared library with Tripo Studio Team Plan.
ads.headline: Keep your game project's assets together
ads.audience: European game studio leads, technical artists and project teams
ads.angle: Organize the character, prop and environment work belonging to the same game project.
ads.visual: Two clear top text columns separate the claim from the concrete project use. Removed asset numbers, project micro-labels, arrow row and duplicate footer slogan. Enlarged the paired assets under one shared-project-library heading; shortened the final title to eliminate a heading/subtitle collision.
ads.evidenceNote: The library capability is verified. The atlas is GPT-generated 2D concept art; it does not prove automatic style consistency, support for every file type, or production readiness.

ads.title: 3D generation. Your pipeline.
ads.primary: Submit a generation task, track its status and retrieve the model after success with Tripo API. Then review it for your game.
ads.headline: Submit. Track. Retrieve. Then review.
ads.audience: US game developers, technical artists and asset-tool engineers
ads.angle: Asynchronous 3D generation integrated into game and asset tools.
ads.visual: 单一主标题与用途；右列只留提交、查询、成功后取回；删除第二套流程及图内标签。
ads.evidenceNote: API task creation, status queries and successful-result retrieval are verified. This is a workflow illustration with GPT 2D artwork, not an executed API example or a game-ready result.

ads.title: Your tools. A new dimension.
ads.primary: Add Tripo API to your game tools: submit tasks, query status and retrieve successful results for review and refinement.
ads.headline: Add 3D generation to the tools you build
ads.audience: US game developers, technical artists and asset-tool engineers
ads.angle: Make 3D generation part of an existing developer-controlled tool workflow.
ads.visual: 保留品牌大字与大模型；删竖排边栏、重复任务关系及微标签，工作流细节留在配文。
ads.evidenceNote: Developer integration is verified as an API capability. Integration requires engineering; pictured GPT 2D art is not a returned mesh, and one request does not automatically finish the whole pipeline.

ads.title: Put products in perspective.
ads.primary: Add image-to-3D generation to your product-content tools with Tripo API. Review each model before using it in a product display.
ads.headline: 3D generation for product-content tools
ads.audience: European enterprise product-content, design-technology and application teams
ads.angle: Business use: model generation as part of a product-display content workflow.
ads.visual: 统一顶部标题与用途层级，完整产品居中展示，删装饰编号和重复产品标签；CTA独立底部。
ads.evidenceNote: Image-to-3D integration is verified; product-display use is an intended application. The chair is concept art, not an exact digital twin, verified model, or an implemented viewer.

ads.title: Make room for 3D.
ads.primary: Build Tripo API into your content tools. Retrieve models after successful tasks, then review them for your product experiences.
ads.headline: Bring 3D generation into enterprise content
ads.audience: European enterprise product-content, design-technology and application teams
ads.angle: Connect asynchronous model generation to enterprise product-content tools.
ads.visual: 重建两列：左列标题、用途、CTA共轴；右列完整产品。删掉平台加号公式、重复步骤与图下标签。
ads.evidenceNote: Task retrieval and developer integration are verified. The product-experience direction is illustrative, not a deployed customer solution, exact product reproduction, or measured business result.
